title: Every variable substitution copies the entire live run transcript (quadratic allocation on big runs)
existing_state: ScriptContext.SubstituteVariables (Services/Scripting/ScriptContext.cs:625-644) unconditionally takes the shared StateLock and materializes the whole pane transcript via _sharedState.OutputWindow.ToString() (line 635) on EVERY call — even when the input string contains no ${_outputwindow} or ${_output} token; it also always runs the ${_output} Replace (line 639). The transcript grows continuously during execution: SshExecutionService appends every received output chunk via outputWindowContext?.AppendOutputWindowText(e.Output) (Services/SshExecutionService.cs:1640, also 1803) under the same lock. SubstituteVariables has 109 call sites across 39 command classes (every send/print/http/notify/sftp/etc., typically several calls per step), so a loop-heavy script against verbose devices copies an ever-growing multi-megabyte string per interpolation — copies over 85KB land on the Large Object Heap. Relatedly, the shared FullOutput StringBuilder (ScriptContext.cs:108) is appended on every RecordCommandOutput/EmitOutput (lines 860, 883) with no cap — unlike localcmd, which has a per-command max_output_bytes.
recommendation: In SubstituteVariables, only snapshot the transcript when the input actually references it: guard the lock/ToString with an Ordinal Contains check for ${_outputwindow} and the Replace with a Contains check for ${_output}. Optionally add a configurable character cap (keep-tail) on the shared Output/OutputWindow builders for runaway loop scripts, mirroring localcmd's max_output_bytes. Both changes are local to ScriptContext.cs.
user_benefit: Long fleet runs and scheduled jobs with chunky device output stop progressively slowing down and churning the GC/LOH; the live-output handler also stops contending on the lock during interpolation-heavy loops.

evidence.note: unconditional lock + OutputWindow.ToString() + Replace on every substitution
per-chunk AppendOutputWindowText keeps the transcript growing during the run
unbounded shared Output StringBuilder appended on every command output and EmitOutput
